status: READINESS ONLY, revised after the architect review of 2026-08-27. Implemented and statically tested. The K1 probe builds a module and measures it through the REAL production transplant; it runs NO warm-up, NO training, NO rollout, NO PPO. NOT EXECUTED.
objective: establish, before any GO for the critic-only warm-up can be issued, that every input the warm-up would consume is present at its pinned bytes (K0) and that the module it would build behaves as claimed (K1): a live 84-wide critic, a byte-identical transplant of the ten J19A actor tensors, sigma exactly 0.005, and a freeze mechanism that demonstrably cuts the actor out of the gradient graph.

two_stages_not_one.rule: readiness and execution are separate GOs. This document preregisters BOTH, but authorises NEITHER.
two_stages_not_one.K0_K1: V26C_J20_CRITIC_WARMUP_READINESS - audit plus probe. Writes one leaf, j20_runs/j20_critic_warmup_readiness_v26c_2026-08-27_r1.
two_stages_not_one.warmup: V26C_J20_CRITIC_WARMUP - the single warm-up execution. NOT implemented here, NOT reachable from the readiness runner, and gated by its own separate architect GO.
two_stages_not_one.why: the architect's standing rule that a report and an audit close every phase before the next begins. Concatenating a probe and a warm-up in one execution would make the probe's verdict unauditable before the warm-up consumed it.

manifest_overlay.blocker_it_resolves: the J19A manifest carries no actor_feature_names, so warm_start._load_actor_feature_manifest raises ValueError at warm_start.py:163-168 and warm_start.resolve_source_actor_features auto-discovers that manifest from inside the module directory at warm_start.py:200-205. A transplant pointed at the J19A module directory fails before any tensor is copied.
manifest_overlay.scope_of_the_defect: J19A's is the only one of the 85 actor_feature_manifest.json files in the repository that lacks the key
manifest_overlay.resolution: a content-addressed overlay carrying the 35 names and explicit provenance. The J19A manifest is NOT corrected in place and no byte of the J19A leaf is touched.
manifest_overlay.provenance: the 35 names are transcribed from 13 committed artefacts that all agree; the preflight re-reads every one of them and refuses any disagreement
manifest_overlay.how_the_leaf_manifest_is_bypassed: the warm-up command passes the overlay explicitly with --warm-start-raw-source-feature-manifest, so auto-discovery never runs
manifest_overlay.the_overlay_is_DIRECTLY_CONSUMABLE: actor_feature_names, actor_feature_count and actor_digest sit at the TOP level, because warm_start._load_actor_feature_manifest reads them from there. A first draft nested the list under a documentation key and was rejected at runtime with the same ValueError the overlay exists to avoid; the keys were hoisted for that measured reason. The other two keys are optional for warm_start and hard-checked when present, so including them turns the transplant into a fail-closed provenance check.
manifest_overlay.no_substitute_manifest_exists: the J2, J8 and J15 manifests carry their own actor_digest, which warm_start hard-checks at warm_start.py:236-240. Pointing one of them at the J19A module would be refused, correctly, as a provenance mismatch.
manifest_overlay.source_config_is_deliberately_not_suppli: the J19A run directory holds no training_cfg.resolved.yaml, because J19A was an offline supervised fit and not a training run. warm_start.resolve_source_config falls back to a path that does not exist, which is NOT an error: the transplant report records source_config_exists false. That is truthful, and inventing a config to fill the field would not be.
manifest_overlay.precedent: v26c_j18_provenance_overlay_j8_2026-08-27.json, the same treatment the architect ordered for the stale J8 leaf manifest
manifest_overlay.it_also_declares_a_stale_status_field: the J19A manifest says 'closed-loop A-F NOT run', which was true when J19A was committed and is false since J19B and J19C. Declared in the overlay, not corrected.

training_health_telemetry.nature: OBSERVATION ONLY, and contained. It adds no key to the environment info, changes no reward term, no dynamic, no threshold and no control flow, and no failure of its own can propagate into the training loop.

two_fields_beyond_the_five_requested.observed_rows: without a denominator, 'zero incidents' is not a health statement. Zero incidents over zero observed rows is silence, and this field is what tells the two apart.
two_fields_beyond_the_five_requested.timeout_side_disagreement_rows: v26c_j1_collect RAISES when reward_terms and phase_fsm disagree about a timeout, and when a timeout carries a side that is neither stance nor swing. A sampling callback must never raise, so the same two anomalies are counted instead of thrown.

sources.phase_timeout_stance_rows: reward_terms.phase_timeout_exceeded > 0 and reward_terms.phase_timeout_side == 1.0; the side code 1.0 = stance and 2.0 = swing is set in prosthetic_phase_fsm.py lines 1685-1689 and 1707-1711

training_health_telemetry.why_max_and_not_last: under the v3 cancellation contract valid_hs_count can DECREASE, so a last-row reading would understate what happened. This is v26c_j1_collect._summarise's own rule, transcribed.

real_zero_versus_missing_telemetry.rule: a row whose telemetry is absent contributes observed_rows 0.0 and missing_telemetry_rows 1.0, and NO incident counter at all. A readable row contributes observed_rows 1.0, missing_telemetry_rows 0.0 and every counter.
real_zero_versus_missing_telemetry.consequence: a counter reading 0 over an iteration means 'observed and did not happen', never 'never looked'. In the JSONL row a field that never arrived is null, never 0.0.
real_zero_versus_missing_telemetry.why: a silent 0.0 would turn missing instrumentation into a clean bill of health - the exact failure mode v26c_j1_collect refuses by raising
real_zero_versus_missing_telemetry.tested: see training_health_telemetry.tested: the suite must pass IN FULL, and its sha256 is pinned by the readiness runner. The real-zero cases specifically cover every required key individually made absent, NaN, infinite, non-numeric and None, plus the per-row and aggregate partition identities.

training_health_telemetry.equivalence_with_the_validated_aggregati: the counting rule is cross-checked against committed traces AND their committed receipts: J12 cell F, the only trace in the chain carrying non-zero FSM events, plus J19C cells G and H. Not against a reimplementation.
training_health_telemetry.it_is_not_a_gate: no threshold is introduced. These values are recorded and reported; nothing terminates, blocks or rolls back on them.

observed_and_missing_partition.rule: observed_rows and missing_telemetry_rows PARTITION every row: exactly one of the two is 1.0 for any row, so per row they sum to 1 and over an iteration they sum to the number of rows the callback saw.
observed_and_missing_partition.what_observed_rows_counts: rows whose required telemetry was present and finite, i.e. rows that could actually be read
observed_and_missing_partition.zero_incidents_over_zero_observed_rows: is silence, NOT health. A fully blind iteration reports observed_rows 0 and missing_telemetry_rows equal to the row count, so the reading cannot be mistaken for a clean bill.
observed_and_missing_partition.corrected_on: 2026-08-27, architect review point A. The first implementation initialised observed_rows to 1.0 on every row, which made it a row counter and let an unreadable iteration report a healthy-looking zero.
observed_and_missing_partition.tested: per-row observed + missing == 1 on every case, aggregate observed + missing == the row count, and a 500-row fully blind iteration asserted to report observed_rows 0

containment.rule: the telemetry exists only to observe, so it must never be able to stop what it observes. Every failure surface is caught at its own boundary.
containment.extraction: training_health_row raising is caught in _log_training_health; the step contributes nothing and sampling continues
containment.metrics_logger: each log_value call is guarded individually, so one hostile field does not suppress the other seven
containment.tensorboard: only training_health/ tags take the guarded path in log_result_scalars
containment.jsonl: _training_health_metrics degrades to all-None, never to zeros
containment.why_that_matters: guarding every TensorBoard tag would silently change the failure behaviour of pre-existing metrics, which nobody asked for. The guard is surgical and the negative case is asserted by test.
containment.diagnostic: one stderr line per failure category per process, emitted from a path that is itself guarded so a diagnostic cannot reintroduce the failure it reports
containment.corrected_on: 2026-08-27, architect review point B. The first implementation only DECLARED that it could not interrupt sampling.
containment.tested: hostile logger on every field and on one field, throwing extraction, hostile TensorBoard writer, hostile env_metrics, warn-once behaviour, and the negative case that a non-health TensorBoard failure still propagates

training_health_telemetry.tested: validation/test_training_health_telemetry.py, which must pass IN FULL. At this sealed revision that is 161 checks, and the suite's sha256 is pinned by the readiness runner, so the count here cannot disagree with the file without the preflight failing first.

K1_probe.what_it_does: constructs ONE module of the pinned class at the pinned geometry with inference_only=False, transplants the ten J19A actor tensors through the REAL production path - warm_start.transplant_actor_state driven by warm_start.resolve_source_actor_features against the explicit overlay - and measures 29 properties, P01 to P29
what_it_never_does: write any byte of the J19A leaf

the_one_place_it_touches_autograd.what: a single backward pass over one synthetic zero batch, to measure where gradients reach
the_one_place_it_touches_autograd.why_it_is_needed: freeze_actor is implemented by detaching the policy logits (asymmetric_rl_module.py lines 86-88 and 154). Whether the graph is really cut is a property of the built module, and asserting it without measuring it would be exactly the kind of unverified claim this pipeline refuses.
the_one_place_it_touches_autograd.control_arm: the same probe is run on an UNFROZEN module built identically. A probe that finds no actor gradient proves nothing unless it can show it would have found one.
the_one_place_it_touches_autograd.safety: every actor tensor is re-verified byte-identical to J19A's on disk AFTER the backward pass, and the whole J19A leaf is re-hashed against its seven pinned hashes

the_gait_clock_zeroing.what_happens: gait_clock_enable is false in the pinned runtime, so the transplant zeroes the target columns for gait_phase_sin and gait_phase_cos (warm_start.DISABLED_GAIT_CLOCK_FEATURES, applied at train_ppo_mlp.py:1784-1799)
the_gait_clock_zeroing.why_it_changes_nothing: columns 0 and 1 of the J19A pi.0.0.weight, and their pi_encoder.0.weight aliases, are ALREADY exactly zero at the bit level. The zeroing is therefore a no-op.
the_gait_clock_zeroing.why_it_is_checked_anyway: if it were not a no-op, the warm-up would perturb the actor before the first gradient, and the byte-identity gate would fail for a reason nobody had anticipated. Check P17 measures it in advance.

K1_probe.byte_identity_method: same dtype, same shape, same C-order bytes. Deliberately NOT numpy.array_equal, which is numeric and would call a float32 tensor equal to a float64 one and -0.0 equal to +0.0.
K1_probe.probe_full_module_state_is_evidence_not_: it carries the ten J19A actor tensors byte-identical plus six freshly-initialised critic tensors, no optimizer state, and was never trained. It is not a candidate, not a checkpoint and not promotable. It exists so that gate G7's semantics can be demonstrated before the warm-up rather than argued about after it.
K1_probe.fresh_critic_digest_is_recorded_but_neve: this stage claims no reproduction of any prior fresh-critic digest and invents no threshold on it

authoritative_path.what: warm_start.transplant_actor_state, the function train_ppo_mlp itself calls, driven by warm_start.resolve_source_actor_features against the explicit overlay
authoritative_path.why_not_a_bare_load: a bare load_state_dict(strict=False) exercises a path production does not take. It would prove nothing about the transplant's column algebra, its gait-clock zeroing, or its refusal to touch the critic.
authoritative_path.source_actor_feature_manifest: v26c_j20_actor_feature_manifest_overlay.json, passed EXPLICITLY so auto-discovery never reaches the leaf manifest
authoritative_path.target_feature_contract: taken from the LIVE environment's own recorded actor_feature_names in a committed J19C cell, NOT from the manifest that describes the source. Using the source manifest for both sides would make the contract agree with itself by construction and prove nothing.
authoritative_path.target_geometry: 35D actor, 84D critic. No 25D actor, no widening, no contralateral feature.
authoritative_path.corrected_on: 2026-08-27, architect review point C. The first probe only exercised load_state_dict(strict=False).

bare_load_is_secondary_only.what_it_shows: loading the actor-only export into a trainable module leaves the six critic tensors at their fresh initialisation, with NO exception and NO warning
bare_load_is_secondary_only.why_it_is_kept: the silent-fresh-critic behaviour is worth having on the record

preregistered_gates_for_the_single_warmu.aggregate_rule: PASS if and only if every gate below passes. Any failure is FAIL_CLOSED: evidence is preserved and there is NO retry.

gates.name: exactly one logical iteration
gates.criterion: train_iterations.jsonl holds exactly one row and its iteration is 1

gates.name: the sampled lifetime delta is exactly the batch
gates.criterion: num_env_steps_sampled_lifetime is exactly 4096 after the single iteration, and the per-iteration delta is exactly 4096
gates.why_it_is_written_this_way: 4096 is TIMESTEPS PER ITERATION, not a number of environments and not a cumulative total. The apparent growth seen in multi-iteration runs is num_env_steps_sampled_lifetime accumulating one batch per iteration; pinning the delta as well as the total makes the two impossible to confuse.

gates.name: the critic metrics are finite
gates.criterion: vf_loss and the value-function explained variance are present and finite
gates.explicitly_not_a_performance_gate: NO threshold on explained variance or vf_loss is set. July set none either: its two warm-ups recorded 0.598 and 0.238 and both were passed. Inventing a bar here would repeat the J18 max-drift error - a number nobody calibrated, rejecting everything.

gates.name: the mean KL is zero
gates.criterion: the reported mean KL is exactly 0.0, or numerically null within 1e-09
gates.why: with the actor detached the policy ratio is identically 1. A non-zero KL would mean the freeze did not hold.

gates.name: the actor is bit-exact at every audit
gates.criterion: every actor_freeze_audit entry reports exact=true and max_abs_diff=0.0, before training and after the iteration, and the actor digest equals d4a13ff742266e9643012a27c57a6ea6b9205b030529d4c7a8af6d874ab26e96 at every entry

gates.name: the log-std is bit-exact
gates.criterion: rows 2:4 of pi.1.weight and pi.1.bias are byte-identical to J19A's - same dtype, same shape, same C-order bytes - and sigma remains exactly 0.005
gates.why_it_is_separate_from_G5: freeze_actor detaches the whole logits tensor and therefore subsumes the log-std, but subsumption is an implementation property. The log-std is checked on its own so the guarantee does not depend on it.

gates.name: the critic digest changed
gates.criterion: critic_state_audit's before_training and after_iteration digests differ
gates.why: a critic warm-up that left the critic untouched would have warmed nothing

gates.name: the full module file hash differs from J19A's, and the actor tensors do not
gates.criterion: the SHA-256 of the committed full module state MUST NOT equal 8153dc9765cb984ae05502b57283c00c09b12de2c4b9d5128a0de0fc12566530, while all ten actor tensors inside it are byte-identical to J19A's
gates.why: the full module carries six critic tensors J19A does not have, so the FILE hash cannot match and requiring it to match would be a category error. The binding comparison is on the actor TENSORS.
gates.already_demonstrated: check P27 of the K1 probe demonstrates exactly this property before the warm-up runs

gates.name: the checkpoint is complete and the optimizer is restorable
gates.criterion: the run writes a full RLlib checkpoint containing learner_group/learner/state.pkl with an optimizer entry, and learner_group/learner/rl_module/default_policy/module_state.pkl with all 16 keys; a separate zero-iteration restore audit reloads it and reproduces both the actor digest and the critic digest exactly

gates.name: no retry, no crash, no timeout
gates.criterion: exit code 0, exactly one process, no supervisor restart, no watchdog hard-exit, no iteration or sampling timeout, and no autonomous retry whatever the outcome

gates.name: the training-health telemetry arrived
gates.criterion: the single iteration's training_health block is present with observed_rows equal to 4096 and missing_telemetry_rows equal to 0, and observed_rows + missing_telemetry_rows equal to 4096
gates.explicitly_not_a_behavioural_gate: the FSM and morphology counters are RECORDED, not bounded. This gate asserts only that the instrumentation reported, so a later reading of those counters is a measurement rather than a silence.

gates.name: the J19A leaf is byte-unchanged
gates.criterion: all seven J19A leaf files re-hash to their pinned values after the run

the_sealed_warmup_command.rule: one shot, one process, no supervisor, no retry. --worker-process is what makes main() fall through to run() instead of entering run_supervised()'s restart loop, so a crash is a failure and never a retry.
the_sealed_warmup_command.scientific_parameters_are_not_on_the_com: they live in the derived, hashed config, so the invocation cannot silently disagree with the document that was preregistered
the_sealed_warmup_command.the_runner_is_the_single_source_of_this_: v26c_j20_critic_warmup_readiness.sealed_command(); the test suite asserts the runner and this document agree token by token

placeholders.<OUTPUT_DIR>: an ABSOLUTE path to a FRESH directory; run() creates it with exist_ok=True and does NOT refuse a non-empty one, so reusing a directory would silently inherit its train_iterations.jsonl history

the_sealed_warmup_command.verified_against_the_real_parser: the command was parsed by train_ppo_mlp.parse_args and passed all four validators - _validate_rl_module_args, _validate_warm_start_args, _validate_start_sampling_args and _validate_kl_guard_args - with no SystemExit. No training, no Ray and no environment were started to check it.
the_sealed_warmup_command.why_the_model_flags_are_repeated_on_the_: freeze_actor, freeze_logstd and asymmetric_actor_critic already come from the derived config, and argparse's set_defaults makes the YAML value survive when the flag is absent. They are repeated so the sealed command is self-evident: a reader should not have to open a YAML to see that this is a frozen-actor run.
the_sealed_warmup_command.what_worker_process_disables: main() reads 'if not args.worker_process: raise SystemExit(run_supervised(args))'. With the flag, run_supervised is never entered: no restart loop, no subprocess respawn, no crash-retry and no supervisor_state.json. A crash is a failure, not a retry.
